critical_issues.msg: Route is missing authentication guard — any unauthenticated user can access the edit form. (Rule 56)
critical_issues.suggestion: Wrap the exported component with an AuthGuard HOC, or add a redirect check using useCurrentUser / useAuthStore at the top of the component.

critical_issues.msg: Next.js 15+ makes params a Promise; accessing Number(params.id) synchronously will produce incorrect behavior or a type error. (Rule 27)
critical_issues.suggestion: Use the params promise pattern: change the signature to async and await params, or use the useParams() hook: const { id } = useParams(); const ruleId = Number(id);

critical_issues.msg: Route is missing authentication guard — any unauthenticated user can view the rule detail. (Rule 56)
critical_issues.suggestion: Wrap the exported component with an AuthGuard HOC or add a redirect check using useAuthStore at the top of the component.

critical_issues.msg: useAutomationLogs has an undeclared status parameter — the page never passes status to the query, making the filter dead code. (Rule 27)
critical_issues.suggestion: Add a status Select dropdown (All / Success / Failed / Skipped) and pass the selected value as the 4th argument to useAutomationLogs.

critical_issues.msg: Route is missing authentication guard — unauthenticated users can read all automation execution logs. (Rule 56)
critical_issues.suggestion: Wrap PerRuleHistoryPage with an AuthGuard HOC or add a redirect check using useAuthStore at the top.

critical_issues.msg: Unsafe type cast — casting API response to `{ data?: { id?: number } }` silently skips if the structure differs, leaving ruleId undefined and silently routing to rules list without enabling
critical_issues.suggestion: Define a typed response interface for useCreateAutomationRule or use a discriminated union so ruleId is extracted with compile-time safety

critical_issues.msg: The falsy check 'initialValues.actions?.length' is always false for an empty array, so an empty actions list always gets one auto-created blank action appended.
PUT /rules/{rule_id} omits `Path(..., ge=1)` on rule_id, leaving it unvalidated unlike every other route in this file.
critical_issues.suggestion: Add `rule_id: int = Path(..., ge=1)` to match the pattern used on GET, PUT, and DELETE.

critical_issues.msg: test_get_rule_raises_not_found_for_missing_id catches bare `Exception` — too broad, masks wrong exception types and makes the test pass for the wrong reason (Rule 25).
critical_issues.suggestion: Catch the specific exception type that AutomationService.get_rule raises (e.g., NotFoundException from pkg.errors.app_exceptions), not Exception.

suggestions.msg: Implementation plan for the automation rules UI feature; no code issues to flag.
RuleBuilder receives disabled={updateRule.isPending} but RuleBuilderProps does not declare a disabled prop — the prop is silently ignored and the form stays interactive during submission. (Rule 27)
suggestions.suggestion: Add disabled?: boolean to RuleBuilderProps and wire it through the form and all interactive children.

suggestions.msg: toRuleBuilderValues is an inner function recreated on every render. (Rule 28)
suggestions.suggestion: Move toRuleBuilderValues to module scope, or wrap with useCallback if it must be reactive.

suggestions.msg: Badge receives colorClass (e.g. 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800') that is not a declared CVA variant — the component ignores it and renders the 'default' variant style, so the badge colors are wrong. (Rule 91)
suggestions.suggestion: Add 'blue' / 'green' / 'gray' variants to badge.tsx CVA config, or replace colorClass with inline styles: <span style={{backgroundColor:'#dbeafe',color:'#1e40af'}}>.

suggestions.msg: router.push navigates to /automation/rules/<id>/history?rule_id=<id> — the query param is redundant since the ID is already in the path segment. (Rule 91)
suggestions.suggestion: Navigate to router.push('/automation/rules/${ruleId}/history') without the query param, and update history/[rule_id]/page.tsx to read the ID from useParams() instead of useSearchParams.

suggestions.msg: useAutomationLogs(page, 20, ruleId ?? undefined) omits the 4th status parameter entirely — callers cannot supply it even if they wanted to. (Rule 91)
suggestions.suggestion: Pass undefined explicitly as the 4th arg to match the hook's current positional signature, or refactor the hook to accept status as a named optional parameter.

suggestions.msg: File is named [rule_id] but reads from useSearchParams (URL query string) instead of the path parameter — this forces an awkward double-ID URL (path + query). (Rule 91)
suggestions.suggestion: Replace useSearchParams with useParams(): const { rule_id } = useParams(); const ruleId = rule_id ? Number(rule_id) : null; and navigate without a query string.

suggestions.msg: STATUS_COLORS keys (success/failed/skipped) are not registered Badge CVA variants, so the colorClass is silently dropped by the Badge component. (Rule 91)
suggestions.suggestion: Add success/failed/skipped variants to the Badge CVA config in badge.tsx, or switch the status column to inline-styled spans.

suggestions.msg: NaN from invalid rule_id param is truthy and bypasses the null check, sending a non-number to the API
suggestions.suggestion: Add validation: `const ruleId = ruleIdParam && !Number.isNaN(Number(ruleIdParam)) ? Number(ruleIdParam) : undefined`

suggestions.msg: Unused import: History is imported but never used
suggestions.suggestion: Remove `History` from the import statement

suggestions.msg: Error from useCreateAutomationRule.mutateAsync is caught but not surfaced to the mutation state — callers of createRule.isError have no way to know the mutation failed
suggestions.suggestion: Rely on createRule.isError / createRule.error instead of local submitError state, or remove the local error and pass the error to the mutation hook

suggestions.msg: Unused import: History is imported but never used
suggestions.suggestion: Remove `History` from the import statement

suggestions.msg: Error from createRule.mutateAsync is caught but not read from the mutation object — if the API returns an error, local state error is set instead, inconsistent with how callers check isError
suggestions.suggestion: Remove local error state; surface errors via createRule.isError / createRule.error from the mutation hook

suggestions.msg: Unused import: CheckCircle2 is imported but never used
suggestions.suggestion: Remove `CheckCircle2` from the import statement

suggestions.msg: No validation on required params — e.g. notification.send accepts empty user_id or message, allowing invalid payloads to reach the API.
suggestions.suggestion: Add required-field validation in handleSubmit of rule-builder.tsx, or disable the Submit button when required params are blank.

suggestions.msg: Priority param uses a free-text Input instead of a constrained Select, allowing invalid values like 'critical' that the backend may reject.
suggestions.suggestion: Replace the Input with a Select offering exactly 'low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent' options.

suggestions.msg: updateType silently discards all existing params when the action type changes, potentially losing user input without warning.
suggestions.suggestion: Preserve only the params that are valid for the new type, or warn the user before resetting.

suggestions.msg: The 'field' input accepts any arbitrary string with no validation against the known CRM field set, risking typos and invalid rule definitions.
suggestions.suggestion: Replace the free-text Input for 'field' with a Select driven by a CONSTANTS.FIELDS list, or add client-side validation against a known field schema.

suggestions.msg: React key prop uses array index 'i' — if conditions are reordered or removed mid-list, React may mis-match component state.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a stable unique id per condition (e.g. crypto.randomUUID()) instead of the loop index.

suggestions.msg: React key prop uses array index 'i' — same risk as condition-row mapping.
suggestions.suggestion: Use a stable unique id per action.

suggestions.msg: Unlike actions, conditions default to an empty array — a rule with zero conditions is accepted silently with no indication in the UI.
suggestions.suggestion: When initialValues is absent and conditions would be empty, consider pre-adding one blank ConditionRow so the user sees the conditions section.

suggestions.msg: Submit button has no loading/disabled state during the async onSubmit call, allowing double-submits.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a local isSubmitting state that disables the button and shows a spinner while onSubmit is pending.

suggestions.msg: No success feedback is shown after onSubmit resolves — the form appears unchanged and the user has no confirmation the save succeeded.
suggestions.suggestion: Call a toast/notification on resolution of onSubmit to confirm success, or reset/disable the form.

suggestions.msg: React key prop uses numeric index 'i' in the conditions.map call — same index-as-key concern as action-row.
suggestions.suggestion: Assign a stable id when making conditions (e.g. { id: crypto.randomUUID(), field: '', operator: 'eq', value: '' }) and use that as key.

suggestions.msg: React key prop uses numeric index 'i' in the actions.map call.
suggestions.suggestion: Assign a stable id when making actions and use it as key.

suggestions.msg: TRIGGER_EVENTS is exported as a plain array constant with no type-safe enum — callers can pass any string to TriggerSelector without TypeScript guard.
suggestions.suggestion: Define as a const assertion type: export const TRIGGER_EVENTS = [...] as const; export type TriggerEvent = typeof TRIGGER_EVENTS[number]['value'];

suggestions.msg: Positional argument `true` for `unreadOnly` is harder to read than the named equivalent.
suggestions.suggestion: Change `useNotifications(1, true)` to `useNotifications({ page: 1, unreadOnly: true })` or at minimum use `useNotifications(1, unreadOnly=true)` for clarity.

suggestions.msg: Variable name `unreadCount` conflates two distinct concepts: the badge count and the total notifications on page 1.
suggestions.suggestion: Rename to `unreadTotal` or `notifTotal` and add a brief comment noting it is only valid when `unreadOnly=true`.

suggestions.msg: `useNotifications` hook has no `onError` handler; a failed fetch silently degrades to `unreadCount = 0` without user feedback.
suggestions.suggestion: Add `useNotifications(1, true)` with an `onError` callback that logs the failure, or surface the error in the UI.

suggestions.msg: Query key for `useActivity` is defined inline as `['activity', id]` instead of via the centralized `qk` registry, breaking discoverability.
suggestions.suggestion: Add `activity: (id: number) => ['activity', id] as const` to `qk` and replace the inline key.

suggestions.msg: useReminders call omits the generic type parameter on apiClient.get, causing the return type to be inferred as `any` rather than a typed ApiEnvelope.
suggestions.suggestion: Add generic: `apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<Record<string, unknown>>>('/api/v1/reminders?upcoming_only=${upcomingOnly}', token ?? undefined)`.

suggestions.msg: No mutation hook invalidates `qk.automationLogs(...)` after rule creation/update/delete, so the logs panel stays stale after a rule is toggled or created.
suggestions.suggestion: Add `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['automation_logs'] })` to `onSuccess` in useCreateAutomationRule, useUpdateAutomationRule, and useToggleAutomationRule.

suggestions.msg: Items in update_data['conditions'] can never have model_dump after model_dump(exclude_unset=True) strips unset fields, making hasattr(model_dump) always false.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the hasattr(model_dump) branch: `update_data['conditions'] = [dict(c) for c in update_data['conditions']]`.

suggestions.msg: Same dead hasattr(model_dump) check applies to update_data['actions'].
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the hasattr(model_dump) branch: `update_data['actions'] = [dict(a) for a in update_data['actions']]`.

suggestions.msg: Service exceptions in /trigger are caught globally but the frontend has no mutation invalidation for the automation rules cache, so UI may not reflect triggered rule state changes.
suggestions.suggestion: Frontend: add `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['automation_rules'] })` to the mutation that fires the trigger event.

suggestions.msg: Class-level @pytest.mark.integration is redundant with module-level pytestmark; duplicate markers add noise.
suggestions.suggestion: Remove `@pytest.mark.integration` from line 19.

suggestions.msg: test_list_logs_filtered_by_status passes status=failed but asserts only response shape — the filter is exercised but its correctness is not verified.
suggestions.suggestion: Seed a rule, trigger an event that fails, then assert that the failed log appears in filtered results while other statuses are excluded.

suggestions.msg: No integration test exists for PUT /rules/{id} partial-update path (conditions=None, actions=None) — an important edge case given the nullable AutomationRuleUpdate fields.
suggestions.suggestion: Add a test that updates only `name` while leaving conditions and actions as null to verify the service handles missing fields correctly.

suggestions.msg: Bare `except Exception` silently swallows all errors during JSON tag parsing in MockRow.__init__ (Rule 25).
suggestions.suggestion: Catch a more specific exception (e.g., `json.JSONDecodeError`) or re-raise after logging, to avoid masking programming errors.

suggestions.msg: MockRow.get() raises NotImplementedError for list-based rows but this is inconsistent with __getitem__ which handles int indices (Rule 25).
suggestions.suggestion: Implement get() for list-based rows consistently, or remove the method to fail explicitly rather than silently.

suggestions.msg: make_automation_handler stores automation rules in state.customers dict instead of a dedicated automation store (Rule 110 / convention misuse).
suggestions.suggestion: Add an 'automations' dict to MockState and use it here, to avoid mixing domains.

suggestions.msg: Bare except-pass block silently discards AttributeError if SQLAlchemyWarning category doesn't exist (Rule 25).
suggestions.suggestion: Use `warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=SQLAlchemyWarning)` with an explicit import, or log a warning instead of silent pass.

suggestions.msg: Handler routing uses case-insensitive str(sql).strip() which may not faithfully represent the SQL text for all SQLAlchemy expression objects (Rule 28 / hidden coupling).
suggestions.suggestion: Document that handlers expect string-coercible SQL, or add a helper that extracts text robustly from both text() and expression objects.

suggestions.msg: MockResult.mappings().one_or_none() raises MultipleResultsFound for >1 rows, but callers may not handle this edge case (Rule 25 / 49).
suggestions.suggestion: Consider returning the first row instead of raising, or document that callers must handle MultipleResultsFound explicitly.

suggestions.msg: test_update_rule_preserves_unmodified_fields has identical duplicate assertions on lines 472-473 and 474-475 (Rule 18 / dead code smell).
suggestions.suggestion: Remove the second pair of duplicate assertions.

suggestions.msg: test_automation_rules_ui.py defines its own make_mock_session, MockRow, and MockResult that are nearly identical to the ones in tests/unit/conftest.py — this is significant duplication (Rule 110).
suggestions.suggestion: Import make_mock_session, MockRow, MockResult from tests.unit.conftest and extend only the execute_side_effect customization inline, rather than duplicating the full implementation.

suggestions.msg: Assertion `assert '规则' in str(exc_info.value)` uses a hardcoded Chinese string that ties test readability to a specific locale, and checks the wrong thing — it validates error message wording instead of the exception type (Rule 63 / 49).
suggestions.suggestion: Assert on the exception type (NotFoundException) rather than a translatable string in the message; move the locale check to a separate i18n test if needed.

suggestions.msg: test_create_rule_allows_empty_name_in_service only asserts `hasattr(rule, 'id')` and never checks the returned name is actually empty — the assertion is too weak to confirm the intended behavior (Rule 63).
suggestions.suggestion: Add `assert rule.name == ''` to verify the empty name was actually stored and returned.

suggestions.msg: execute_side_effect is defined as a plain function rather than AsyncMock, unlike the actual session.execute call on line 36 — inconsistent with how async SQL is handled elsewhere (Rule 29).
suggestions.suggestion: Make execute_side_effect async or document why plain function is intentional here.

suggestions.msg: SQL type detection via `hasattr(sql, '__str__') and 'insert' in str(sql).lower()` is fragile — spacing, comments, or quoted strings could cause false negatives (Rule 49).
suggestions.suggestion: Use a more robust SQL pattern matcher or add a comment documenting the string-matching contract and its known limitations.

warnings.msg: test_update_rule_preserves_unmodified_fields has identical duplicate assertions on lines 472-473 and 474-475 (Rule 18 / dead code smell).
warnings.suggestion: Remove the second pair of duplicate assertions.

warnings.msg: test_automation_rules_ui.py defines its own make_mock_session, MockRow, and MockResult that are nearly identical to the ones in tests/unit/conftest.py — this is significant duplication (Rule 110).
warnings.suggestion: Import make_mock_session, MockRow, MockResult from tests.unit.conftest and extend only the execute_side_effect customization inline, rather than duplicating the full implementation.

warnings.msg: Assertion `assert '规则' in str(exc_info.value)` uses a hardcoded Chinese string that ties test readability to a specific locale, and checks the wrong thing — it validates error message wording instead of the exception type (Rule 63 / 49).
warnings.suggestion: Assert on the exception type (NotFoundException) rather than a translatable string in the message; move the locale check to a separate i18n test if needed.

warnings.msg: test_create_rule_allows_empty_name_in_service only asserts `hasattr(rule, 'id')` and never checks the returned name is actually empty — the assertion is too weak to confirm the intended behavior (Rule 63).
warnings.suggestion: Add `assert rule.name == ''` to verify the empty name was actually stored and returned.

warnings.msg: execute_side_effect is defined as a plain function rather than AsyncMock, unlike the actual session.execute call on line 36 — inconsistent with how async SQL is handled elsewhere (Rule 29).
warnings.suggestion: Make execute_side_effect async or document why plain function is intentional here.

warnings.msg: SQL type detection via `hasattr(sql, '__str__') and 'insert' in str(sql).lower()` is fragile — spacing, comments, or quoted strings could cause false negatives (Rule 49).
warnings.suggestion: Use a more robust SQL pattern matcher or add a comment documenting the string-matching contract and its known limitations.

llm_parsed.summary: Reviewed 18 file(s) between origin/master and origin/auto/issue-65.

parsed.summary: Implementation plan for the automation rules UI feature; no code issues to flag.

issues.message: Route is missing authentication guard — any unauthenticated user can access the edit form. (Rule 56)
issues.suggestion: Wrap the exported component with an AuthGuard HOC, or add a redirect check using useCurrentUser / useAuthStore at the top of the component.

issues.message: Next.js 15+ makes params a Promise; accessing Number(params.id) synchronously will produce incorrect behavior or a type error. (Rule 27)
issues.suggestion: Use the params promise pattern: change the signature to async and await params, or use the useParams() hook: const { id } = useParams(); const ruleId = Number(id);

issues.message: RuleBuilder receives disabled={updateRule.isPending} but RuleBuilderProps does not declare a disabled prop — the prop is silently ignored and the form stays interactive during submission. (Rule 27)
issues.suggestion: Add disabled?: boolean to RuleBuilderProps and wire it through the form and all interactive children.

issues.message: toRuleBuilderValues is an inner function recreated on every render. (Rule 28)
issues.suggestion: Move toRuleBuilderValues to module scope, or wrap with useCallback if it must be reactive.

parsed.summary: Page is missing auth protection and has a Next.js 15 params compatibility issue; submit loading state is silently ignored by RuleBuilder.

issues.message: Route is missing authentication guard — any unauthenticated user can view the rule detail. (Rule 56)
issues.suggestion: Wrap the exported component with an AuthGuard HOC or add a redirect check using useAuthStore at the top of the component.

issues.message: Badge receives colorClass (e.g. 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800') that is not a declared CVA variant — the component ignores it and renders the 'default' variant style, so the badge colors are wrong. (Rule 91)
issues.suggestion: Add 'blue' / 'green' / 'gray' variants to badge.tsx CVA config, or replace colorClass with inline styles: <span style={{backgroundColor:'#dbeafe',color:'#1e40af'}}>.

issues.message: router.push navigates to /automation/rules/<id>/history?rule_id=<id> — the query param is redundant since the ID is already in the path segment. (Rule 91)
issues.suggestion: Navigate to router.push('/automation/rules/${ruleId}/history') without the query param, and update history/[rule_id]/page.tsx to read the ID from useParams() instead of useSearchParams.

parsed.summary: No auth guard, and Badge's colorClass prop is silently dropped because it doesn't match any declared CVA variant.

issues.message: useAutomationLogs has an undeclared status parameter — the page never passes status to the query, making the filter dead code. (Rule 27)
issues.suggestion: Add a status Select dropdown (All / Success / Failed / Skipped) and pass the selected value as the 4th argument to useAutomationLogs.

issues.message: Route is missing authentication guard — unauthenticated users can read all automation execution logs. (Rule 56)
issues.suggestion: Wrap PerRuleHistoryPage with an AuthGuard HOC or add a redirect check using useAuthStore at the top.

issues.message: useAutomationLogs(page, 20, ruleId ?? undefined) omits the 4th status parameter entirely — callers cannot supply it even if they wanted to. (Rule 91)
issues.suggestion: Pass undefined explicitly as the 4th arg to match the hook's current positional signature, or refactor the hook to accept status as a named optional parameter.

issues.message: File is named [rule_id] but reads from useSearchParams (URL query string) instead of the path parameter — this forces an awkward double-ID URL (path + query). (Rule 91)
issues.suggestion: Replace useSearchParams with useParams(): const { rule_id } = useParams(); const ruleId = rule_id ? Number(rule_id) : null; and navigate without a query string.

issues.message: STATUS_COLORS keys (success/failed/skipped) are not registered Badge CVA variants, so the colorClass is silently dropped by the Badge component. (Rule 91)
issues.suggestion: Add success/failed/skipped variants to the Badge CVA config in badge.tsx, or switch the status column to inline-styled spans.

parsed.summary: Missing auth guard, dead status filter, and useSearchParams reading what should be a path param; Badge colors won't render.

issues.message: NaN from invalid rule_id param is truthy and bypasses the null check, sending a non-number to the API
issues.suggestion: Add validation: `const ruleId = ruleIdParam && !Number.isNaN(Number(ruleIdParam)) ? Number(ruleIdParam) : undefined`

issues.message: Unused import: History is imported but never used
issues.suggestion: Remove `History` from the import statement

parsed.summary: History page renders a paginated log table with good UX but has a NaN-parsing bug and an unused import.

issues.message: Error from useCreateAutomationRule.mutateAsync is caught but not surfaced to the mutation state — callers of createRule.isError have no way to know the mutation failed
issues.suggestion: Rely on createRule.isError / createRule.error instead of local submitError state, or remove the local error and pass the error to the mutation hook

parsed.summary: New rule page is minimal and correct, but its local error state diverges from the mutation's own error tracking.

issues.message: Unused import: History is imported but never used
issues.suggestion: Remove `History` from the import statement

parsed.summary: Rules list page is clean and well-structured with good hover interactions and toggle controls.

issues.message: Unsafe type cast — casting API response to `{ data?: { id?: number } }` silently skips if the structure differs, leaving ruleId undefined and silently routing to rules list without enabling
issues.suggestion: Define a typed response interface for useCreateAutomationRule or use a discriminated union so ruleId is extracted with compile-time safety

issues.message: Error from createRule.mutateAsync is caught but not read from the mutation object — if the API returns an error, local state error is set instead, inconsistent with how callers check isError
issues.suggestion: Remove local error state; surface errors via createRule.isError / createRule.error from the mutation hook

issues.message: Unused import: CheckCircle2 is imported but never used
issues.suggestion: Remove `CheckCircle2` from the import statement

parsed.summary: Templates page is functionally complete but has an unsafe type cast on the API response and diverges error-handling style from the mutation's own error state.

issues.message: No validation on required params — e.g. notification.send accepts empty user_id or message, allowing invalid payloads to reach the API.
issues.suggestion: Add required-field validation in handleSubmit of rule-builder.tsx, or disable the Submit button when required params are blank.

issues.message: Priority param uses a free-text Input instead of a constrained Select, allowing invalid values like 'critical' that the backend may reject.
issues.suggestion: Replace the Input with a Select offering exactly 'low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent' options.

issues.message: updateType silently discards all existing params when the action type changes, potentially losing user input without warning.
issues.suggestion: Preserve only the params that are valid for the new type, or warn the user before resetting.

parsed.summary: ParamsForm renders per-action inputs correctly but lacks required-field validation and uses free-text where a constrained Select would be safer.

issues.message: The 'field' input accepts any arbitrary string with no validation against the known CRM field set, risking typos and invalid rule definitions.
issues.suggestion: Replace the free-text Input for 'field' with a Select driven by a CONSTANTS.FIELDS list, or add client-side validation against a known field schema.

issues.message: React key prop uses array index 'i' — if conditions are reordered or removed mid-list, React may mis-match component state.
issues.suggestion: Use a stable unique id per condition (e.g. crypto.randomUUID()) instead of the loop index.

issues.message: React key prop uses array index 'i' — same risk as condition-row mapping.
issues.suggestion: Use a stable unique id per action.

parsed.summary: ConditionRow is clean in structure but the free-text 'field' input is a data-integrity gap, and index-based keys are a React correctness concern.

issues.message: The falsy check 'initialValues.actions?.length' is always false for an empty array, so an empty actions list always gets one auto-created blank action appended.
issues.suggestion: Change to: initialValues.actions?.length ? initialValues.actions : [makeAction()]

issues.message: Unlike actions, conditions default to an empty array — a rule with zero conditions is accepted silently with no indication in the UI.
issues.suggestion: When initialValues is absent and conditions would be empty, consider pre-adding one blank ConditionRow so the user sees the conditions section.

issues.message: Submit button has no loading/disabled state during the async onSubmit call, allowing double-submits.
issues.suggestion: Add a local isSubmitting state that disables the button and shows a spinner while onSubmit is pending.

issues.message: No success feedback is shown after onSubmit resolves — the form appears unchanged and the user has no confirmation the save succeeded.
issues.suggestion: Call a toast/notification on resolution of onSubmit to confirm success, or reset/disable the form.

issues.message: React key prop uses numeric index 'i' in the conditions.map call — same index-as-key concern as action-row.
issues.suggestion: Assign a stable id when making conditions (e.g. { id: crypto.randomUUID(), field: '', operator: 'eq', value: '' }) and use that as key.

issues.message: React key prop uses numeric index 'i' in the actions.map call.
issues.suggestion: Assign a stable id when making actions and use it as key.

parsed.summary: rule-builder.tsx has a logic bug on empty-actions initialization and lacks loading-state protection for the submit button; index-as-key is a recurring React correctness issue.

issues.message: TRIGGER_EVENTS is exported as a plain array constant with no type-safe enum — callers can pass any string to TriggerSelector without TypeScript guard.
issues.suggestion: Define as a const assertion type: export const TRIGGER_EVENTS = [...] as const; export type TriggerEvent = typeof TRIGGER_EVENTS[number]['value'];

parsed.summary: trigger-selector.tsx is minimal and correct; the only concern is the lack of a type-safe TriggerEvent union for the exported constant.

issues.message: Positional argument `true` for `unreadOnly` is harder to read than the named equivalent.
issues.suggestion: Change `useNotifications(1, true)` to `useNotifications({ page: 1, unreadOnly: true })` or at minimum use `useNotifications(1, unreadOnly=true)` for clarity.

issues.message: Variable name `unreadCount` conflates two distinct concepts: the badge count and the total notifications on page 1.
issues.suggestion: Rename to `unreadTotal` or `notifTotal` and add a brief comment noting it is only valid when `unreadOnly=true`.

issues.message: `useNotifications` hook has no `onError` handler; a failed fetch silently degrades to `unreadCount = 0` without user feedback.
issues.suggestion: Add `useNotifications(1, true)` with an `onError` callback that logs the failure, or surface the error in the UI.

parsed.summary: Sidebar correctly surfaces notification badge count; positional API arg and variable naming are rough edges but not functional defects.

issues.message: Query key for `useActivity` is defined inline as `['activity', id]` instead of via the centralized `qk` registry, breaking discoverability.
issues.suggestion: Add `activity: (id: number) => ['activity', id] as const` to `qk` and replace the inline key.

issues.message: useReminders call omits the generic type parameter on apiClient.get, causing the return type to be inferred as `any` rather than a typed ApiEnvelope.
issues.suggestion: Add generic: `apiClient.get<ApiEnvelope<Record<string, unknown>>>('/api/v1/reminders?upcoming_only=${upcomingOnly}', token ?? undefined)`.

issues.message: No mutation hook invalidates `qk.automationLogs(...)` after rule creation/update/delete, so the logs panel stays stale after a rule is toggled or created.
issues.suggestion: Add `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['automation_logs'] })` to `onSuccess` in useCreateAutomationRule, useUpdateAutomationRule, and useToggleAutomationRule.

parsed.summary: Hook registry is well-structured; inline query key and missing invalidation for automation logs are the main gaps.

issues.message: PUT /rules/{rule_id} omits `Path(..., ge=1)` on rule_id, leaving it unvalidated unlike every other route in this file.
issues.suggestion: Add `rule_id: int = Path(..., ge=1)` to match the pattern used on GET, PUT, and DELETE.

issues.message: Items in update_data['conditions'] can never have model_dump after model_dump(exclude_unset=True) strips unset fields, making hasattr(model_dump) always false.
issues.suggestion: Remove the hasattr(model_dump) branch: `update_data['conditions'] = [dict(c) for c in update_data['conditions']]`.

issues.message: Same dead hasattr(model_dump) check applies to update_data['actions'].

issues.message: Service exceptions in /trigger are caught globally but the frontend has no mutation invalidation for the automation rules cache, so UI may not reflect triggered rule state changes.
issues.suggestion: Frontend: add `qc.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['automation_rules'] })` to the mutation that fires the trigger event.

parsed.summary: Router follows the service pattern correctly; missing Path validation on PUT rule_id is the critical gap, dead hasattr code is the main style issue.
